prose: SPECTRA is a neural compression engine and runtime claiming to compress LLMs about 3x near-losslessly with under 50 MB of RAM, aimed at 4-8 GB consumer GPUs. It targets the memory wall: single-token generation reads the whole weight matrix per token, so bandwidth, not arithmetic, bounds edge inference. Supported examples include DeepSeek-R1-Distill, IBM Granite-3B, Llama-3.2, Nemotron-3-Nano and LFM-3. Claims are the project's own.
highlights: Claims about 3x compression, near-lossless, under 50 MB RAM
